body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「我們把 prompt 放進 Git，也有 `v12` 標籤。出現一個奇怪輸出時，是否已足夠追查？」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「足夠，因為我可以看到 prompt 改過甚麼。」

## Prompt 只是一次輸出的其中一個輸入

Versioned prompt 很重要，但它沒有告訴你當時究竟跑了甚麼。一次 LLM workflow 的行為還可能受 model ID、sampling / reasoning setting、system instruction、輸入資料、檢索到的 source snapshot、context 組裝次序、工具權限、schema、parser、fallback route、evaluation rubric 和 human override 影響。若只保存 prompt，兩次看似同一版本的 run 仍可以用不同資料、不同模型或不同工具能力，產生完全不同結果。到有問題時，你只能猜。

Audit trail 的目的不是儲存每一個 token，而是讓人能重建一個足夠小的決定。把 `run_id` 連到 input fixture 或其 hash、prompt version、model/config、source receipt、route reason、tool calls 的 allow/deny 結果、schema validation、eval case version、最終 status 和 handoff owner。對敏感或不可公開的內容，保留最小化 metadata、redacted fixture 或 hash，不要因為想可追溯就把 private text 全部倒進 log。

## 食譜版本不等於廚房紀錄

食譜的第十二版只會告訴你菜譜改了哪一行。它不會告訴你那天用了哪種米、焗爐幾多度、誰把鹽多放了一匙，或食客最後把菜退回。Prompt version 像食譜；audit trail 是足夠重做與解釋那一餐的廚房紀錄。

## 答題時要交代嘅判斷

先定 audit question：我們要回答「為何這個 case 被交人？」「為何 output 不合 schema？」「某次改動令哪類 fixture 退步？」還是「誰批准它只作草稿？」不同問題決定 trace 粒度。然後把可重跑的 fixed eval 與可讀的 release note 放在一起。Prompt change 必須透過同一組 case 比較 Evidence Delta，並由明確 gate 決定繼續、回退或需要人工判讀。沒有固定 comparison 的 version number，只是命名。

## 答案何時會太薄

不要一開始做全量 observability 平台。最小 baseline 可以是十個無敏感資料的 static fixtures，加一行 JSONL run record 和一份 `CHANGE-001.md`。每次只記錄輸入 ID、設定、結果狀態和 checker。若這條小鏈已不能解釋一個 failure，才增加 source receipt、tool trace 或更細的 reason code。把所有 prompt 都收進 Git，但沒有固定 case 和 release gate，仍不能驗收行為。

## 技術證據

可檢查 artefact 包括 `prompts/draft-v12.md`、`configs/run-contract.json`、`fixtures/`、`eval-cases.jsonl`、`traces/redacted-run.jsonl`、schema test、allow/deny tool test、`evidence-delta.md` 和 `CHANGE-001.md`。每個 trace 至少應連回 input ID、prompt/model/config、source snapshot ID、route、validator result、eval version 和 terminal status。README 解釋哪些欄位被 redaction、hash 不能還原甚麼，以及如何以 static fixture 本地重跑。

## 交付、業務與風險證據

另外定義誰讀 trace、誰可以批准 prompt 變更、何時一個 output 只可保留為 draft、發現 regression 後如何 rollback，以及 log 的保留和存取界線。Auditability 不是監控所有使用者，也不是把資料收得愈多愈好；它是讓有責任的人在合理資料最小化下，能追查一個可被指出的決定。不要把本地 trace 或 prompt diff 描述成已符合任何機構稽核要求。

## 延伸閱讀

[Prompt、context compaction 與 multilingual eval](/zh-HK/articles/prompt-patterns-context-compaction-and-multilingual-evals)、[LLM eval、human review 與 observability](/zh-HK/articles/llm-evals-human-review-and-observability) 和 [Agent workflow 不只評 final answer](/zh-HK/articles/evaluate-an-ai-agent-workflow-not-just-the-final-answer)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。prompt、fixture、trace、變更紀錄和結果均為虛構教學草稿；不含真實對話、任何機構資料、連接器紀錄或已通過的合規／稽核結論。

> 答对一半的答案：“足够，因为我可以看到 prompt 改过什么。”

Versioned prompt 很重要，但它没有告诉你当时到底跑了什么。一次 LLM workflow 的行为还可能受到 model ID、sampling / reasoning setting、system instruction、输入数据、检索到的 source snapshot、context 组装顺序、工具权限、schema、parser、fallback route、evaluation rubric 与 human override 影响。若只保存 prompt，两次看似同一版本的 run 仍可能用不同数据、不同模型或不同工具能力，产生完全不同结果。出问题时，你只能猜。

先定 audit question：我们要回答“为何这个 case 被交人？”“为何 output 不合 schema？”“某次改动让哪类 fixture 退步？”还是“谁批准它只当草稿？”不同问题决定 trace 粒度。接着把可重跑的 fixed eval 与可读的 release note 放一起。Prompt change 必须通过同一组 case 比较 Evidence Delta，并由明确 gate 决定继续、回退或需要人工判读。没有固定 comparison 的 version number，只是命名。

不要一开始做全量 observability 平台。最小 baseline 可以是十个无敏感数据的 static fixtures，加上一行 JSONL run record 和一份 `CHANGE-001.md`。每次只记录输入 ID、设置、结果状态与 checker。若这条小链已经不能解释一个 failure，才增加 source receipt、tool trace 或更细的 reason code。把所有 prompt 收进 Git，但没有固定 case 与 release gate，仍不能验收行为。

body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “We store the prompt in Git and tag it `v12`. Is that enough to investigate a strange output?”
>
> Half-right answer: “Yes, because I can see what changed in the prompt.”

## A prompt is only one input to an output

A versioned prompt matters, but it does not say what actually ran. An LLM workflow can also be affected by model ID, sampling or reasoning settings, system instruction, input data, retrieved source snapshot, context assembly order, tool permissions, schema, parser, fallback route, evaluation rubric, and a human override. With only a prompt saved, two runs that appear to share a version can still use different data, models, or tool capability and produce very different results. When something fails, you can only guess.

The purpose of an audit trail is not to store every token. It is to reconstruct a sufficiently small decision. Connect a `run_id` to an input fixture or its hash, prompt version, model and configuration, source receipt, route reason, allow or deny result for tools, schema validation, evaluation-case version, terminal status, and handoff owner. For sensitive or non-public material, retain minimised metadata, a redacted fixture, or a hash. Do not pour private text into logs merely in the name of traceability.

## Recipe versions are not kitchen records

Version twelve of a recipe tells you which recipe line changed. It does not tell you which rice was used that day, oven temperature, who added extra salt, or whether the diner sent the dish back. A prompt version is the recipe. An audit trail is the kitchen record sufficient to reproduce and explain that meal.

## The judgement an interviewer is listening for

Name the audit question first. Are you answering “Why was this case handed to a person?”, “Why did output violate the schema?”, “Which fixtures regressed after this change?”, or “Who approved draft-only use?” Different questions require different trace granularity. Pair rerunnable fixed evaluation with a readable release note. A prompt change should compare Evidence Delta on the same cases and pass a clear gate to continue, roll back, or request human interpretation. A version number without a fixed comparison is only a name.

## Where an answer goes thin

Do not start by building a full observability platform. A minimal baseline can be ten non-sensitive static fixtures, one JSONL run record, and `CHANGE-001.md`. Record only input ID, configuration, result status, and checker. If that small chain cannot explain a failure, add a source receipt, tool trace, or finer reason code. Putting every prompt into Git without fixed cases and a release gate still cannot accept behaviour.

## Technical evidence

Inspectable artefacts include `prompts/draft-v12.md`, `configs/run-contract.json`, `fixtures/`, `eval-cases.jsonl`, `traces/redacted-run.jsonl`, a schema test, allow-and-deny tool tests, `evidence-delta.md`, and `CHANGE-001.md`. Each trace should at least link an input ID to prompt, model, configuration, source-snapshot ID, route, validator result, evaluation version, and terminal status. The README explains redaction, what a hash cannot restore, and how to rerun locally with static fixtures.

## Delivery, business, and risk evidence

Define who reads a trace, who may approve a prompt change, when output remains draft-only, how a regression rolls back, and log-retention and access boundaries. Auditability is not monitoring every user, nor is it collecting the most data possible. It lets accountable people trace a named decision while minimising data. Do not describe a local trace or prompt diff as satisfying any organisation's audit requirement.

## Further reading

[Prompts, context compaction, and multilingual evaluation](/en/articles/prompt-patterns-context-compaction-and-multilingual-evals), [LLM evaluation, human review, and observability](/en/articles/llm-evals-human-review-and-observability), and [evaluate an agent workflow, not only its final answer](/en/articles/evaluate-an-ai-agent-workflow-not-just-the-final-answer).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. Prompts, fixtures, traces, change records, and results are fictional teaching-draft material. It contains no real conversation, organisation data, connector record, or passed compliance or audit conclusion.
